Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<algorithm>
#include<vector>
#include<queue>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int findKthLargest(vector<int>& nums, int k) {
        sort(nums.begin(),nums.end());
        return nums[nums.size() - k];   /* 最后1个数(index是len-1)是第1大，而不是第0大。于是第k大的数的index的 len-1-(k-1) = len - k */
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = { 3,2,1,5,6,4 };
    int k = 2;
    auto res = sol.findKthLargest(nums, k);
    cout << res << endl;
    return 0;
}
